notes.title: Developer's Note: Game Hints and Playtime Guide
notes.notes: [p]Hello, Visitors![/p][p]Thank you so much for playing my game.[/p][p]For those of you who might be stuck or struggling with a puzzle,[/p][p]I've prepared a small guide to help you.[/p][p][/p][p][b]1. Hints File Guide[/b][/p][p]A [b]hints.txt[/b] file is included in the game's installation folder.[/p][p]This file contains a few hints that may help you with the game's core puzzles and story progression. While I recommend trying to solve the puzzles on your own, if you find yourself truly stuck, feel free to refer to this file for help.[/p][p][/p][p][b]2. Playtime Guide[/b][/p][p]The estimated playtime for The Nest is approximately 1 hour. Of course, this time can be shorter or longer depending on your play style.[/p][p]I hope you enjoy the game's journey at your own pace.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you once again for your interest and support.[/p]

notes.title: The Nest is OUT NOW! Come visit the mansion
notes.notes: [p]🕰️ Release Date: August 12th[/p][p]🪹 Price: $4.99[/p][p]🪶 A 10% launch discount will be available.[/p][p][/p][p]The Nest is a first-person psychological horror adventure game.[/p][p]We're excited to have you step into the mansion![/p][p][/p][p]Note on Translations:[/p][p]The in-game text currently uses automatic translation.[/p][p]If there is strong interest and enough wishlist additions from your country, we will actively consider adding an official translation in a future update.[/p][p][/p][p]Feedback and Suggestions:[/p][p]We'd love to hear your thoughts! If you encounter any issues or have suggestions for improvements while playing, please let us know in the comments or discussions.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support![/p]
